register.labelZh: CHEW 片語動詞的實際用途
register.summaryZh: chew on 表示反覆咬着某物;chew up 則表示把某物嚼碎或咬成小塊。；chew something over 和 chew on something 可以表示仔細考慮一個構思、問題或提議。；chew somebody out 可以幫助你理解某人受到嚴厲責罵的情境。；chew on 既可以描述咬東西的動作,也可以表示仔細思考。你需要根據整句判斷意思。
register.summaryEn: Chew on focuses on repeatedly biting something, while chew up shows that the object is bitten into small pieces. Chew something over and chew on something can show that you are considering an idea, problem or offer carefully. Chew somebody out helps you understand situations in which someone is angrily and severely criticised. Chew on can describe a physical action or careful thought. The full sentence tells you which meaning is intended.
